Card C11923-K2 is blocked, an internal case is created, and a regulatory report is filed due to the device's connection to fraud on multiple cards.

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report concerns customer C11923, card C11923-K2, and related cards C03938-K1 and C05595-K1 linked through shared device SM-G610F Build/NRD90M. On 2016-12-29 at 03:27:44, an unauthorized online charge of $131.30 (product C) appeared on card C11923-K2. The customer explicitly denied making this transaction. The fraudulent purchase originated from device SM-G610F Build/NRD90M running Chrome 66.0 for Android, identified as new to customer C11923's account with no prior usage history on card C11923-K2. Within 24 hours, this same device initiated suspicious online transactions on card C03938-K1 ($125.72) and card C05595-K1 ($125.59), both rated suspicious by the bank's detection model. The pattern indicates coordinated card-not-present fraud across multiple accounts sharing a single device, consistent with account compromise or credential theft. Per Policy R2 (customer denial of charge) and Policy R6 (device-shared fraud on connected cards), card C11923-K2 has been blocked, investigation case HHG-011 has been opened, and cards C03938-K1 and C05595-K1 placed under enhanced monitoring.
